plan.title: House deposit by November 2028

situation.summary: Holds €25,000 in savings. Can save €800 a month. Gross income €62,000 a year. Car loan: €9,000 at 9%.

products.why: €16,000 in Nordax Bank Fixed Term Deposit for 24 months: the most known interest after DIRT for this part of the money.
unknowns: the minimum age to open it
whether it takes regular monthly saving
checks: Opened through Raisin (raisin.ie), not with Nordax Bank directly: a free Raisin account comes first. The deposit is held by Nordax Bank.
Covered by the Swedish Deposit Guarantee Scheme, not the Irish scheme.
Needs a Raisin account, opened online at raisin.ie.
Check eligibility with Nordax Bank: CCPC does not record who can open it (for example, whether an account with Nordax Bank is needed first).

which deposit guarantee scheme covers it
checks: Check eligibility with bunq: CCPC does not record who can open it (for example, whether an account with bunq is needed first).

debts.why: At 9% it costs more than the savings earn. Clearing from the lump sum and saving its €280 a month leaves €831.10 more at month 24 than keeping it. Keeping it reaches €35,000 sooner, in November 2027 rather than April 2028, with €3,385.33 still owed at the end.

ranking.basis: The split that earns the most interest after DIRT that can be known over 24 months on €16,000 placed and €1,080 a month, for the inputs given; debts set against savings by net position at month 24.

assumptions: DIRT at 33% is deducted from interest, except on products the source marks DIRT-free.
Interest accrues monthly at a twelfth of the AER and is credited every twelve months and at the end.
Variable rates are assumed to stay as published today; they can change.
Bonuses are not counted as interest.
Every other euro of savings held is treated as available to place.
A €43,233.88 deposit and €62,000 gross income support a price up to €291,233.88 under the Central Bank limits (the income limit binds).

reasoning: €25,000 held and €800 a month to place, over 24 months.

Car loan: cleared from the lump sum. Net position (savings less debt) at month 24: €43,233.88, against €42,402.78 if kept. Keeping it reaches €35,000 sooner, in November 2027 rather than April 2028, with €3,385.33 still owed at the end.
